2.2.0:
CppAssistant 2.2.0

- PBDS completions now insert <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp> and <ext/pb_ds/tree_policy.hpp> for you (bits/stdc++.h does not cover PBDS); new setting cpp_auto_insert_pbds_includes.
- __gnu_pbds:: namespace completion, C++20 ranges/views/concepts, auto type inference (auto it = v.find(x) -> vector<int>::iterator), complexity hints and origin labels in the popup.
- New commands: Browse Templates (inline preview of the first 20 lines), Manage User Snippets, Fix Full-width Punctuation (Ctrl+Alt+,), Call/Type Hierarchy, Validate Settings.
- Status bar shows the completion source and the call signature you are typing; Find References is grouped and numbered per file.
- The Basic template pack (us/inc/fastio/mainf/solvef/pii) is removed; Geometry, Graph, DS, Strings and Math remain.
See CHANGELOG.md for details.
2.1.1:
CppAssistant 2.1.1

- Menu localization now works: CppAssistant: Toggle Menu Language switches CppAssistant's own menu between English and Chinese.
- Template packs are bundled and install on demand; uninstalled packs stay hidden. Manage enable/disable from the same menu.
- Array bounds checking, template parameter deduction, diagnostic filters and CI fixes.
See CHANGELOG.md for details.
install:
Welcome to CppAssistant!

Quick start:/n1. Open a .cpp/.h file and start typing - semantic completions appear automatically
2. Press F12 to go to definition
3. Press Shift+Alt+F to format the document (jiangly style)
4. Press Ctrl+. for code actions

Key commands:/n- F12: Go to Definition
- Shift+F12: Find References
- Shift+Alt+F: Format Document
- Ctrl+Alt+F: Format Selection
- Ctrl+.: Code Actions
- Ctrl+Alt+R: Rename Symbol
- Ctrl+Alt+D: Show Diagnostics
- Ctrl+Shift+C: Copy Diagnostic
- Ctrl+Alt+,: Fix Full-width Punctuation
- Command Palette: Browse Templates, Call/Type Hierarchy, Validate Settings

Setup clangd (recommended):
- Windows (MSYS2): pacman -S mingw-w64-x86_64-clang
- Linux: sudo apt install clangd
- macOS: brew install llvm
Without clangd the built-in engine still provides completion, F12 and instant checks.

Configuration:/nPreferences > Package Settings > CppAssistant > Settings

Documentation:/n- README.md (English) / README.zh-CN.md (Chinese)
- CHANGELOG.md

For OIers:/n- Geometry, Graph, DS, Strings and Math template packs
- PBDS header insertion, __gnu_pbds namespace completion, C++20 ranges
- Full-width punctuation fix (Ctrl+Alt+,)
- Array bounds checking and bits/stdc++.h PCH acceleration

Tip: set "display_language": "zh" for Chinese diagnostics
